lines.en: I hang under the leaf, turning slowly.

lines.zh: 洋红的壳在绿叶间很扎眼
lines.en: My magenta shell shows sharply against green.
The thread is too fine to see.

lines.zh: 我摆动得很慢，幅度也小
lines.en: I swing slowly, in a small arc.

lines.zh: 丛林的风把我的壳推来推去
lines.en: The jungle wind pushes my shell about.
Now and then I bump the leaf.
I rotate half a turn, then back.
Dew hangs at the tip of my shell.
The leaf is heavy and bends.
I press to the leaf's underside, rocking.
A thread of sun makes my shell shine.
I steady, then sway again.

lines.zh: 洋红在绿里像一朵小花
lines.en: Magenta among green, like a small flower.
Hanging here costs me no effort.

lines.zh: 我不急，壳里还有事没做完
lines.en: No hurry; there is work left inside.

lines.zh: 我晃的时候，颜色也在动
lines.en: As I sway, so does the color.
Magenta stands out far too much here.
I press as close to the leaf as I can.

lines.zh: 这颜色不是我自己选的
lines.en: This color was not my choice.
I wait for it to deepen.
Something shifts inside the shell.
I should not be this conspicuous.
The shadow below is moving.

lines.zh: 我用叶子遮了半个身子
lines.en: I hide half of myself behind the leaf.

lines.zh: 一只鸟落在了上面的枝
lines.en: A bird lands on the branch above.

lines.zh: 我把身子缩进品红色的壳里。
lines.en: I tuck myself deep inside my magenta shell.
The veins on the leaf are fine.
I cannot reckon how long it has been.
I hang in the most obvious spot.
You spotted me at once.
This color gave me away.
You are studying my shell.
Magenta on green is far too bright.
I keep still, hoping you are mistaken.
You have come closer.
All I can do is wait.
Do not pick me off.
Look if you must, but do not touch.
A crack appears in the shell.
I sway almost off the thread.
A patch of the magenta darkens.
Something inside lurches.
I dread that kind of sound.
I cling to the leaf and keep still.
My shell will not take a second blow.

lines.zh: 品红的壳挨了一下，我晃回来。
lines.en: My magenta shell takes a hit and swings back.

lines.zh: 这一刻我什么也做不了
lines.en: I can do nothing at this moment.
Please step back.
I do not feed right now.

lines.zh: 这颜色已经够引人注意了
lines.en: This color draws enough attention.

lines.zh: 你举起的东西我不认识
lines.en: I do not recognize what you hold up.
Hold it farther; the birds will see.
I shrink behind the leaf, unwilling to be seen.

lines.zh: 等我羽化，会有别的吃法
lines.en: Once I emerge, I will eat differently.

lines.zh: 你把东西挂在那儿也没用
lines.en: Hanging it there will not help.
My mouthparts are not formed.
The smell is too strong.
Please put it back.
The leaf jerks.
I knock against a vein.
The thread creaks taut.
I spin several times before stopping.
My shell meets your finger.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的壳晃出水光
lines.en: The blow makes my shell flash wet.
I am pressed flat to the leaf.
The leaf is close to breaking.
I swing in midair.
Do not shake the branch.
Who is this color for?
It will matter once I can fly.
Right now there is only a shell.
My kind are deeper in the jungle.
I am neither hurried nor lonely.

lines.zh: 将来会有人看见这颜色
lines.en: One day someone will see this color.
This shell can do nothing.
Do not ask me such things yet.
I wait for the change to finish.
Only then am I truly myself.
I have not a single hand to spare.
It hangs just below me.
The leaf moved and it fell.
There is no way for me to reach.
You take it.
It does not look like mine.
It has fallen to the ground.
I can only watch.
Do not shake the tree for it.
It is of no use to me.
You have seen me; so look.
I do not run, and cannot.

lines.zh: 洋红在这片绿里藏不住
lines.en: Magenta cannot hide in all this green.
I am two blocks above your head.
This spot is high.
My shell is hard; it will not crush.
Do not use a stick.
I am only hanging here.
What do you mean to do with me?
I wait for you to leave.
You have stayed under the tree.
I hear you circle twice.
The leaves hide half of you too.
I hang still, and you can do nothing.
Even in shade the magenta glows.
I am high above the ground.

lines.zh: 你换个角度也看不到里面
lines.en: No angle will show you what is inside.
I am not your quarry.
When the wind stops, I go still.
Wait a little longer.

lines.zh: 我根本没有攻击的办法
lines.en: I have no means of attack at all.
Touch me and the leaf will break.
My shell will pinch your hand.
If I fall, I crack.
The thread snaps between your fingers.
The magenta shell rolls at your feet.
I have nothing else to give.
I can barely even struggle.
This helps nobody.
Let the leaf go.
A caterpillar hung me here.

lines.zh: 洋红的颜色第一次显出来
lines.en: For the first time the magenta shows.
This leaf is deep in the jungle.
I am more visible than the leaf.
I am firmly fastened.
The canopy drips above.

lines.zh: 我转了半圈，看清了四周
lines.en: I turn half round and take in the surroundings.
There are many birds in this forest.
I must be careful.
This is where the change begins.
Heat comes and the leaf curls first.
I came off the leaf.
Water soaks me through.

lines.zh: 枝叶被撕开，我掉了下去
lines.en: The twig tears away and I fall.

lines.zh: 有东西擦破了我一层壳
lines.en: Something scraped a layer off my shell.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我在里面乱动
lines.en: That force sets me churning inside.

lines.zh: 挂着的时候我并不进食
lines.en: While hanging I do not feed.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我浑身一震
lines.en: Lightning strikes the tree and I jolt.
The leaf is gone; only falling remains.
